summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about the heavenly realms earned by donating cows, prompting a narrative introduction involving Indra questioning Brahma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Nachiketa bows before Yama, the lord of the dead, after hearing teachings on the sacred merit of gifting cows.
Indra stands before Brahma on the lotus throne, asking about the radiant heavenly regions attained by givers of cows.
